species:persian-ibex.reason: Title is the domestic goat (Capra aegagrus hircus), not the wild Persian ibex; the subspecies is what differs.

species:thick-billed-murre.reason: Frame holds two species (crested auklets and thick-billed murres).

species:ornate-chorus-frog.reason: Title binomial is Microhyla fissipes, an Asian narrow-mouthed frog, not Pseudacris ornata.

species:dwarf-salamander.reason: Title is Hillis's dwarf salamander (Eurycea hillisi), split from E. quadridigitata in 2017.

species:kentucky-spring-salamander.reason: Title names the Carolina form (G. p. dunni), not the Kentucky form (G. p. duryi).

species:feral-goat.reason: Title describes a set of poses of a domestic farm goat; a single photograph of a feral animal is wanted.

species:feral-sheep.reason: Title names a domestic breed (Valais Blacknose) on alpine pasture, not a feral population.

species:milksnake.reason: Title subspecies L. t. nelsoni is now generally placed in L. polyzonus, not L. triangulum.

species:three-lined-boa.reason: Title subspecies roseofusca is generally placed in L. orcutti (northern three-lined boa), not L. trivirgata.

species:plains-leopard-frog.reason: Only candidate is a tadpole; the general image should show the adult.

species:six-lined-racerunner.reason: Three-view composite on white; a single natural photograph is wanted.

species:many-lined-skink.reason: Only candidate shows a dead animal impaled by a shrike.
